data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As on April 24, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 72.30 lakh ha as compared to 70.19 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 30.68 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year.
-  As on 24.04.2026, 92.62% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over  India. Approximately 99.58%  area  of  Pulses  mainly  in  Gram  (100%),  Urdbean  (99%)  &  Moong  (86%);  99.50%  area  of Oilseeds  majorly  in  Rapeseed  &  Mustard  (100%);  92.43%  area  of  Shri  Anna  cum  Coarse  Cereals majorly in Jowar (96.97%), 47.89% area of Rice and 94.00% area of Wheat has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (24 April - 30 April 2026):
data.text: -  Appreciably above normal (+3.1 to +5.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over parts of Jammu & Kashmir,  Punjab,  Haryana,  Rajasthan,  Madhya  Pradesh,  Uttar  Pradesh,  Bihar,  Jharkhand,  Odisha, Gangetic West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, Vidarbha, Rayalaseema, Telangana & Kerala; normal to abovenormal maximum temperatures are likely over most parts of the country during the week.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over Northwest India till 28th April; gradual fall  by  3-5°C on 29th & 30th April; gradual rise by 2-3°C on 01st & 02nd May and  over Central India till 27th and gradual fall by 2-3°C.
-  Gradual fall by 2-3°C in maximum temperatures likely over East India during 27thApril -01st May and by 3-4°C in Northeast India during 27th -30th April.

data.heading: Week 2 (01  May - 07 May 2026):
data.text:
-  Low  Probability  of  Heatwave  conditions  likely  during  some  days  of  the  week  over  Rajasthan  & adjoining Punjab & Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, & Vidarbha. Appreciably above normal maximum temperatures are likely over some parts of Jammu & Kashmir, and above-normal maximum temperatures (+1.6 to +3.0°C) are likely over most parts of Northwest & Central India, and many parts of the East & Northeast, and the West coast of India. Near-normal weekly maximum temperatures are likely in isolated places over the rest of the country.
-  No warm night conditions are likely during the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice : About 30.68 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 32.31 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses :  About 17.19 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 15.93 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds :  About 9.21 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 7.71 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
